messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: Unusual IAM binding created. Rule=iam-policy-change-23. Binding: roles/clusterAdmin -> serviceAccount:infra-ci@redwood. Detected 10:02 UTC.

alex: Investigating — pulling audit logs now.

samir: Copy. Marking incident, creating war-room channel #inc-1769998888. Tagging secops.

alex: Found SetIamPolicy from 34.12.45.67 (external). Payload shows member=serviceAccount:infra-ci@redwood and role=roles/clusterAdmin. Also see GenerateAccessToken call. @maria any scheduled infra changes?

maria: No scheduled infra deployments or automation that would do that. Nothing from CI in the last 24h.

lee: Immediate containment — revoke the new binding and disable any keys for infra-ci. alex, can you run removal + key disable?

alex: Running now:
```
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood \ 
  --member='serviceAccount:infra-ci@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com' \ 
  --role='roles/clusterAdmin'
```
Output: "Updated IAM policy." Disabled service account keys for infra-ci. (audit id 0x9f3)

oncall-bot: Audit scan: 3 suspicious API calls from 34.12.45.67 in last 5m — SetIamPolicy, GenerateAccessToken, CreateServiceAccountKey.

samir: Creating ticket SEC-2026-112. Assign: maria (lead), alex (ops), lee (sre).

maria: KMS note — I'll start rotating wrapping keys for secrets used by infra-ci and rotate any HSM-wrapped keys. Also kick off key-access audit. ETA ~30m.

alex: Evidence collection in progress: exporting full audit log window to gs://sec-evidence/1769998888/audit.json and snapshotting VM 34.12.45.67. Notifying GCP support for owner lookup.

lee: Added temporary egress/ingress deny for 34.12.45.67 at network layer. Also created a short-term detector to alert on further SetIamPolicy calls from unknown IPs.

jordan: Notes for post-incident: require RBAC review, reduce infra-ci privileges (least-privilege), add guardrails preventing external IPs from creating high-privilege bindings.

maria: Handoff: I'm stepping off at 11:00 UTC. @samir please take commander and keep the ticket updated. I'll leave checklist pinned in #inc-1769998888: revoked binding, disabled keys, evidence exported, KMS rotation started.

samir: Will take over. Summary for next shift: revoked clusterAdmin binding, disabled service account keys, KMS rotation in progress, firewall block applied to 34.12.45.67, ticket SEC-2026-112 created.

alex: Scribe update: evidence archived to gs://sec-evidence/1769998888/ (audit.json, vm-snap-34.12.45.67.tar), thread pinned to channel.

samir: :white_check_mark: Sending brief to execs: "Detected unauthorized IAM binding; contained; key rotation and forensic collection underway."

maria: Follow-ups added to ticket: org-wide RBAC audit, tighten SA key creation controls, enforce MFA for privileged role changes, add cross-region SetIamPolicy alert.

samir: Handoff complete. Next status update in 30m or on any new alert. @oncall-bot please schedule a follow-up reminder at 1770000688.

oncall-bot: Follow-up reminder scheduled for 1770000688. Incident channel #inc-1769998888 created and pinned.

samir: Closing war-room for now — on-call shift accepted. If anything else pops, re-open.
